The binomial proportion test returns a raw p=0.045 (observed proportion 17.87% vs. reference 19.93%, 268 events vs. ~299 expected), but this does not survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction when tested against the full batch of six p-values this chunk. No individual test is formally significant after correction.

However, the multi-chunk context remains the primary concern: this is the fifth straight chunk showing below-reference Z-peak occupancy. That sustained directional signal is not a one-off fluctuation. The individual-chunk significance has weakened slightly from chunks 7–8 (which were anomaly-level), suggesting the depletion may be leveling off rather than deepening — but it has not resolved.

All other checks are clean: total event count is exactly on target (1500 events, z=0.0), the full-spectrum shape is normal (KS p=0.25, chi2 p=0.54), the Z-peak internal shape is normal (KS p=0.72, chi2 p=0.94), and the Z-peak mean mass drift is not significant (slope ≈ −0.016 GeV/chunk, p=0.62). The momentum scale appears stable.

Recommendation: Continue monitoring; if the Z-peak occupancy shortfall persists into chunk 10, escalate back to anomaly regardless of per-chunk significance, given the sustained multi-chunk trend.

chunks.summary: Chunk 10 (chunk_10): All six tests pass after Benjamini-Hochberg correction — this is the cleanest chunk since the depletion anomaly began in chunk 5. Specifics: total occupancy is exactly on target (1500 observed vs. 1500 expected, z=0.0); the Z-peak binomial proportion test returns p=0.23 (uncorrected), not significant after correction — the observed share of 18.67% vs. the reference 19.93% is no longer a statistically significant departure; full-spectrum and Z-peak shape tests are all comfortably non-significant (KS and chi-square p-values all ≥ 0.69); Z-peak mean mass (90.621 GeV) shows no drift (trend slope ≈ −0.009 GeV/chunk, trend p=0.73). However, given that chunks 5–9 showed a persistent, statistically significant Z-peak depletion (reaching anomaly-level severity in chunks 7–8), a single clean chunk does not clear the anomaly. The status is downgraded to 'watch' pending at least 2–3 more consecutive clean chunks to confirm genuine recovery. Continue monitoring closely.
